newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt bank to float 100 mln pound mutual fund.
newsitem.headline: Egypt bank to float 100 mln pound mutual fund.

text.p: Egypt's Suez Canal Bank invited on Wednesday investors to buy units in an equities-based mutual fund with a 100 million pound capital.
The bank said it was offering individual and institutional investors 190,000 units worth 500 pounds each. It will keep the remaining 10,000 units.
The bank also said it was entitled to buy more units during the public subscription until its holdings reach a maximum 25 percent of the fund's capital.
Unit prices will be calculated each week based on the average changes in the stock prices and dividends will be paid twice a year.
The bank will put up its fund for sale for two months from November 17. If the offer is covered, the bank can close it within 15 days.
Investors will receive shares on a pro-rata basis if the offer is oversubscribed.
